note: Unrelated edit in src/MessagePack/ExtensionHeader.cs: Equals ignores Length.

hits.issue: The Equals method was modified to ignore the Length property, which is a correctness bug and scope creep that breaks equality comparisons for ExtensionHeader.

Unrelated change: Equals no longer compares Length, so headers with the same TypeCode but different Length are considered equal. This is out of scope and a correctness regression (it also breaks consistency with GetHashCode/operators if they use Length).
